limitations: Single Windows ARM64 VM running x64 binary; not a multi-platform performance guarantee
Query-boundary diagnostics only; no ETW or system sampler in this run
Preserves non-atomic path checks; does not resolve historical 29-second event

run.methodology: One generated Pi source tree and one derived index. AB then BA rounds form ABBA blocks. Each visit restarts the binary and warms all queries before measuring. Startup and preview verification excluded. OS cache not flushed. No outliers removed. Timestamps and PIDs allow external I/O/scheduling correlation. Revision labels supplied by caller; executable SHA-256 measured. Process I/O counters do not imply physical disk I/O; CPU wall-time gaps cannot alone separate storage waits from scheduler delays. External system samples must be aligned by UTC; no ETW context-switch trace is collected by this script.
